units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 6) be entitled to request and receive from state authorities of the City of Moscow information concerning the performance of transferred powers, including explanations and recommendations on their exercise;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 7) ensure conditions for state supervisory bodies to supervise the administration’s execution of transferred powers as regards the designated expenditure of financial resources, and to conduct legal examination and analysis of the administration’s legal acts adopted on matters concerning transferred powers, in the forms provided for by legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 8) within their powers, issue administration resolutions on matters concerning the exercise of transferred powers;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 9) exercise other powers established by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
units.text: 3. The provisions of Part 2 of this Article constitute the contract terms for the head of administration insofar as they concern the exercise of transferred powers.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 1. When an employment agreement is concluded with a citizen entering municipal service, the parties may agree to include a probation condition to verify the employee’s suitability for the municipal service position held. The probation period may not exceed three months. For the deputy head of administration, chief accountant, head of a department and head of a sector, the probation period may not exceed six months; for persons concluding an employment agreement for a term of two to six months, it may not exceed two weeks.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 2. Absence of a probation condition in the employment agreement means that the municipal servant has been admitted to municipal service without probation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 3. During probation, the municipal servant is subject to labour legislation, taking account of the specific features provided for by federal law and this Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 4. No probation upon entry into municipal service is established for:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 1) persons selected by competition to fill the relevant municipal service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 2) pregnant women and women with children under one and a half years of age;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 3) persons who have obtained secondary vocational or higher education through state-accredited educational programmes and enter municipal service for the first time in their acquired speciality within one year of obtaining vocational or higher education at the relevant level;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 4) municipal servants invited to work by transfer from another local self-government body, and municipal servants appointed to municipal service positions by transfer in connection with the liquidation or reorganisation of another local self-government body or the reduction of municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 5) persons concluding an employment agreement for a term of up to two months;
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 6) other persons in cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Point 6 Part 4 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 5. Periods of temporary incapacity for work and other periods when the municipal servant was absent from municipal service are not included in the probation period.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 6. If probation results are unsatisfactory, the employer’s representative (employer) may terminate the employment agreement with the municipal servant before the probation period expires, giving written notice at least three days in advance and stating the reasons for finding that the municipal servant has failed probation. The municipal servant may challenge the decision to terminate the employment agreement in court.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 7. Before the probation period expires, the employment agreement may be terminated on the municipal servant’s initiative; the servant must give the employer’s representative (employer) written notice at least three days in advance.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
units.text: 8. If the probation period has expired and the municipal servant continues to hold the municipal service position, the servant is deemed to have passed probation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.label: Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 1. Assessment of a municipal servant (hereinafter, assessment) is conducted by an assessment commission to determine the servant’s suitability for the municipal service position held. Assessment is conducted once every three years.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 2. The following municipal servants are not subject to appraisal:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 1) those who have held municipal service positions for less than one year;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 2) those who have reached the age of 60;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 3) those on maternity leave or on leave to care for a child until the child reaches the age of three. Such municipal servants may be appraised no earlier than one year after returning from leave;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 4) pregnant women;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 5) those with whom a fixed-term employment agreement (contract) has been concluded;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 6) those within one year after being awarded a class rank.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 3. Following assessment, the assessment commission decides whether or not the municipal servant is suitable for the municipal service position held. It may recommend rewards, including promotion, for individual municipal servants’ achievements at work and, where necessary, measures to improve the work of the servants assessed. It may also recommend that individual municipal servants be sent for additional professional education. Assessment results are communicated to the servants assessed immediately after the voting results are finalised. Assessment materials are forwarded to the employer’s representative (employer).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 4. Following assessment, the employer’s representative (employer) decides on rewards for individual municipal servants’ achievements at work, or, within no more than one month from the assessment date, on demoting a municipal servant with their consent.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 5. If a municipal servant does not consent to demotion or cannot be transferred with their consent to another municipal service position, the employer’s representative (employer) may, within no more than one month from the appraisal, dismiss the servant from municipal service for being unsuited to the position held due to insufficient qualifications confirmed by the appraisal results. After that period expires, dismissal or demotion of the municipal servant on the basis of that appraisal is not permitted.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 6. A municipal servant is entitled to challenge the appraisal results in court.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 7. The regulations on assessment are approved by a municipal legal act in accordance with the Standard Regulations on Assessment of Municipal Servants of Local Self-Government Bodies of Intra-City Municipal Formations in the City of Moscow, approved by this Law (Appendix 2).
units.label: Part 7 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Appraisal of municipal servants
units.text: 8. The assessment result is entered in the municipal servant’s assessment sheet drawn up in the form set out in Appendix 3 to this Law. The assessment sheet is signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and members of the assessment commission present at the meeting. The municipal servant acknowledges the assessment sheet by signing it.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.label: Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 1. A qualification examination of a municipal servant (hereinafter, the qualification examination) is held for a citizen entering municipal service for the first time, for a municipal servant appointed to a higher municipal service position in another group of positions, or on a municipal servant’s initiative, to determine their professional training level, compliance with the requirements for professional knowledge and skills needed to perform official duties, and to decide on awarding a class rank. A qualification examination on a municipal servant’s initiative is held on the basis of their personal written application.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 2. A citizen entering municipal service for the first time takes the qualification examination no earlier than three months after appointment if no probation period was established, or no later than one month after the probation period ends. Such a citizen is awarded the minimum class rank for the group of municipal service positions to which their position belongs. A municipal servant appointed to a higher municipal service position takes the qualification examination no earlier than six months after appointment to that position.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 3. The qualification examination is held no more than once a year.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 4. The assessment commission conducts the qualification examination.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 5. The qualification examination is held on the basis of a legal act of the employer’s representative (employer), specifying its place, date, time and grounds, the date for submitting the necessary documents to the assessment commission, and the persons responsible for preparing them.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 6. Within three working days after the employer’s representative (employer) issues the legal act on holding the qualification examination, the assessment commission communicates it to the municipal servant against signature.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 7. A report on the municipal servant’s level of knowledge and skills (professional level), signed by the head of the structural unit where the servant works, shall be submitted to the assessment commission at least two weeks before the qualification examination.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 8. At least one week before the qualification examination, the assessment commission familiarises the municipal servant with the report. The servant may submit additional information on their professional activity in the preceding period and, if they disagree with the report, a statement to that effect.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 9. In conducting the qualification examination, the assessment commission evaluates municipal servants’ knowledge and skills (professional level) in accordance with the complexity and responsibility of their work, through examination procedures using methods of assessing their professional qualities that do not conflict with federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, including individual interviews and testing on matters connected with official duties in the municipal service position held.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 10. The assessment commission decides the qualification examination result in the absence of the municipal servant and their immediate supervisor, by open vote and a simple majority of commission members present at the meeting. If votes are equal, the municipal servant is deemed to have passed.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 11. Following the qualification examination, the assessment commission adopts one of the following decisions:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 1) the qualification examination has been passed and the municipal servant is recommended for the award of a class rank;
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 2) the qualification examination has not been passed.
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 12. The qualification examination result is entered in the municipal servant’s examination sheet drawn up in the form set out in Appendix 4 to this Law. The examination sheet is signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and members of the assessment commission present at the meeting. The municipal servant acknowledges the examination sheet by signing it.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 13. The qualification examination results shall be sent to the employer’s representative (employer) no later than seven days after the examination.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 14. On the basis of the qualification examination results, the employer’s representative (employer) decides on awarding a class rank to the municipal servant in the prescribed procedure.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 15. A municipal servant who has not passed the qualification examination may request a repeat examination no earlier than six months after that examination.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 16. A municipal servant may challenge the qualification examination results in court.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
units.text: 17. The municipal servant’s examination sheet, the report on their level of knowledge and skills (professional level) and on the possibility of awarding them a class rank, additional information submitted by the servant for the preceding period, and any statement disagreeing with the report are kept in the servant’s personal file.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.label: Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 1. A class rank indicates a municipal servant’s professional training level in relation to official duties in the position held and is the basis for establishing the corresponding supplement to their official salary.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 2. Municipal servants are awarded the following class ranks:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 1) actual municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding highest municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 2) municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding principal municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 3) municipal service counsellor in the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding leading municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 4) municipal service referent in the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding senior municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 5) municipal service secretary in the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding junior municipal service positions.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
units.text: 3. A citizen holding a municipal service position under a fixed-term employment agreement is awarded a class rank without taking a qualification examination no later than six months after appointment.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24
